items.html: Afterward, a further correction was added in ZA, and it is phase two, which corresponds to the phase of the time of nursing, in which VAK were made in it, and Malchut rose to it, as mentioned. And so it was now, for it has been explained below, regarding the matter of the milk of nursing, how immediately at the beginning of the pregnancy, the menstrual blood of the woman is cut off from her Yesod, and rises up to the place of her breasts, in order to turn into milk.
